decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The measures so approved shall be implemented before the use commences and shall be permanently retained.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 10am to 11pm Monday to Friday and 10am to 12pm on Sunday.
Condition : 7 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times 10am to 11pm Monday to Friday and 10am to 12pm on Sunday.
Condition : 8 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 9am and 6.30pm  nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 9 - The premises shall not be used for the sale of food for consumption off the premises including the provision of a home delivery service.

Condition : 10 - The use hereby permitted for a wine bar shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the floors and the internal walls of the wine bar and the adjoining residential and retail units has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This will also include the building being adapted so as to provide further sound insulation, with windows shut and any back doors to the premises being fitted with a self closer.  The measures so approved shall be implemented before the use commences and shall be permanently retained.
description: Change of use from Launderette to Wine bar
